metadata.title: Best Royal Wedding Banquet FEAST at the SAMODE PALACE, JAIPUR I Desi, Videshi and Rajasthani Zaike
metadata.description:
Get ready for a visual treat of a Royal-themed Indian Wedding! 

Today's episode reveals the enchanting wedding celebrations of our dear friends, Roshni and Ross, at Samode Palace, a boutique hotel near Jaipur. From the captivating venue and joyous spirits to a sumptuous feast, today's episode captures some of the magical moments from the occasion. 

On reaching there, the royal embrace of Samode Palace welcomed us into the enchanting world of Roshni and Ross's wedding. A grand welcome was followed by high tea and mehndi ceremony amidst spirited folk dance performances. 

Next, we saw the groom's royal entry on an elephant for varmala exchange. After that, we went to a glamorous cocktail party. This was followed by a lavish dinner all in the Royal style within the intricately decorated walls of the palace building. The feast featured over 20 Indian and international dishes, offering a symphony of flavors to savour.

The banquet concluded with the sweet allure of desserts. As lively rhythms of music and dance filled the air, we joined everyone for an unforgettable celebration.


About the host:
